subject: Billing entity / payer mismatch on GCP marketplace invoice — request for reassign and VAT evidence
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@apexplus.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: billing@apexplus.com
Date: Thu, 29 Aug 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Billing entity mismatch for August GCP marketplace invoice

Hi Marissa / Jonas,

We're seeing an issue with our August GCP Marketplace invoice (invoice #67821). Usage is showing under the wrong payer entity in the marketplace (ApexPlus-Prod vs ApexPlus-Platform). Our accounting team says the legal entity on the invoice needs to be ApexPlus-Platform (EU VAT: GB123456789) for VAT reclaim and internal cost allocations. Right now it's billed to ApexPlus-Prod, which is causing a VAT and AR mismatch.

Can Redwood reassign the August metering lines to the correct payer entity or advise on the minimal evidence you need to process a retro reallocation / credit? We're preparing the signed PO and a VAT registration certificate to attach. Also including the marketplace usage IDs we think map to the Platform tenant: usage: mkt-usage-892, mkt-usage-893, mkt-usage-912.

Attached: apexplus-aug-invoice-67821.pdf

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Finance, ApexPlus
--
ApexPlus Ltd.
www.apexplus.com
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@apexplus.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Aug 2029 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing entity mismatch for August GCP marketplace invoice

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the invoice. Sorry you're seeing this headache. We can help get this corrected but there are a couple of steps and dependencies across marketplace support and our internal billing ledger. To keep everyone aligned:

Action items (what we need from ApexPlus to move forward):
- Signed PO or formal request on company letterhead (you mentioned you'll attach) — needed for our records when we open the marketplace reallocation request.
- VAT registration certificate for the entity that should receive the invoice (ApexPlus-Platform).
- The mapping CSV of marketplace usage IDs to your internal tenant IDs (so our ops team can map the metering lines).

Internal plan from Redwood:
- We'll open a P1 marketplace reallocation with GCP listing the affected invoice lines and demand a retro credit (typical timeline 2–6 weeks but can vary).
- If the marketplace requires a seller or reseller signoff, we'll coordinate and escalate as needed.
- Finance will hold crediting until evidence is verified; we'll share a temporary offset memo in your portal if needed.

Jonas / Karthik — can you take lead on assembling the usage mapping and estimate how many token/line items will need reassignment? Sara — once you send the PO + VAT doc + mapping we will open the GCP ticket and share the support reference.

I'll open a shared Drive doc for the evidence and post the marketplace support case id when it's created.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Sara Patel <sara.patel@apexplus.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Aug 2029 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing entity mismatch for August GCP marketplace invoice

Sara / Marissa — quick technical detail from ops: attached is a preliminary mapping of the GCP usage IDs we pulled for August. I flagged the lines that look like Platform-related traffic (col A: usage_id, col B: project_id, col C: meter_id, col D: tentative-entity). If ApexPlus confirms the tenant mapping on your side we can scope the reallocation.

Notes / constraints:
- GCP marketplace can do retro reassignments but they require a signed seller acknowledgement or a buyer-official PO + VAT docs.
- If usage is > $100k in a month, their finance team sometimes requires additional tax residency proof (passport/registration) — uncommon but I've seen it.
- There may be an interim ledger offset: Redwood can issue a customer-facing credit memo while we wait for the marketplace to post a formal adjustment, but those credits are subject to our reconciliation rules.

I've attached usage-id-mapping-august.csv for your review. I'll estimate the total USD exposure once we have the confirmed mapping.

Jonas Weber
Marketplace Technical Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachment: usage-id-mapping-august.csv
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@apexplus.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: billing@apexplus.com
Date: Fri, 30 Aug 2029 07:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing entity mismatch for August GCP marketplace invoice

Thanks — attaching the signed PO and our VAT registration for ApexPlus-Platform. The PO number is PO-7832 and total monthly spend in August was ~ $45,600. We confirm the usage mapping in the CSV (we reviewed the three usage IDs you flagged and they do belong to Platform).

Attachments: apexplus-signed-po-7832.pdf
VAT cert (as image) included inside the single PDF.

Request: can you give a target date for when we might see either (A) a Redwood credit memo or (B) a marketplace-posted credit to the account? Our month-end close is Sept 5 so any offsets before that would be ideal.

Appreciate the help — let us know if you need any additional C-level signoff.

Sara
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@apexplus.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 31 Aug 2029 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing entity mismatch for August GCP marketplace invoice

Hi Sara — received the PO and VAT doc, thanks. Quick status / commitments: 

1) I opened case RGW-2029-0887 with our GCP marketplace liaison this morning and attached the invoice, signed PO, VAT cert, and usage mapping. Case ETA from GCP: initial response 3–5 business days, resolution (credit post) 2–6 weeks depending on their internal queue.

2) To support your Sept 5 close, Redwood Finance will issue a provisional customer credit memo for $45,600 to your Redwood billing account by COB Mon, Sep 2. This will appear as a memo in the portal and can be used for your month-end to avoid hitting collections. Final reversal or adjustment will be applied once the marketplace posts the formal credit.

3) Next steps / ask from ApexPlus: please sign the DocuSign acknowledgement I've sent (link below) confirming Redwood may submit the marketplace reallocation request on your behalf and accept a provisional internal credit. We need that signed before we escalate to GCP senior finance.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/1a2b3c-sign-apexplus

I'll follow up in the case thread and share the GCP reference number once GCP acknowledges. If GCP requires seller signoff we'll loop in your platform ops contact.

If anything changes I'll update the thread.

Regards,
Marissa
Head of Marketplace Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
